Introduction We introduce Ling-3.1-flash-1019, an upgraded version of Ling-3.1-flash, with 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters per token, and a 1M-token context window.

## Ficha rápida

- inclusionAI/Ling-3.1-flash-1019
- 572B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 391.6 GB (Multi-GPU / servidor)
- ~13 tok/s en 8× H100 (FP8)
- licencia mit
- 85 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

🤗 Hugging Face    |   🤖 ModelScope    |   🐙 OpenRouter   

Introduction We introduce Ling-3.1-flash-1019, an upgraded version of Ling-3.1-flash, with 560B total parameters, 25B active parameters per token, and a 1M-token context window. With further post-training optimizations, Ling-3.1-flash-1019 demonstrates significant improvements in reasoning and real-world agentic capabilities. Its AA-Briefcase score rises from approximately 1400 to 1524 Elo, while performance on AutomationBench-AA increases from 62% to 68%. The model also makes gains on scientific benchmarks, including CritPt (18% → 26%) and SciCode (54% → 57%).
